recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Future changes to the patient-animal extension definition should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack; core should only update active Patient narrative, examples, or references if they become misleading.
issue_request: FHIR-14880 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request from the STU3 ballot asking to remove the Patient.animal backbone from base Patient, provide the same animal details through a standard extension, and include descriptive veterinary usage text in Patient notes.
initial_application: Historical GF#14880 commits e3d290e779 and a059d60658 applied the change: e3d290e779 disabled Patient.animal spreadsheet rows, introduced patient-animal extension content, and converted the animal Patient example to the extension; a059d60658 added the Veterinary Care notes section.
additional_context: Current core source has no Patient.animal element in source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml. The active Patient resource still covers animal patients, source/patient/patient-example-animal.xml uses http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-animal, and source/patient/patient-notes.xml links to the extension through the Extension Pack location. The standard extension definition now lives in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/Patient/StructureDefinition-patient-animal.xml. The only remaining core Patient.animal path reference is in source/profiles/cda.profile.xml, whose fhir.ini entry is commented out. FHIR-14393 and FHIR-18328 support the same interpretation but were not independently decided in this seed run.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because active core already omits the backbone element, uses and links the standard extension, and keeps only build-scoped Patient guidance/examples in core.

related_jiras.note: Resolved no-change because moving Patient.animal to an extension eliminated the need for meaning-when-missing semantics on the removed backbone element.
Published technical correction changed wording from animal element to animal extension; current Extension Pack wording and core references are consistent with that correction.
